message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and let me tell you, my family group chat lit up brighter than any flashlight! Between the frantic "Is everyone okay?" messages and the kids arguing over who gets to use the power bank first, it was chaos—but the good kind. We ended up sharing our favorite snacks from the pantry, swapping stories, and even played a few rounds of charades by lantern light. It reminded me that even in the dark, we can find a way to connect and have some fun. How do you keep the good vibes going during a power outage?
